items.title: Best Buy (BBY) Appoints Anne Bramman As CFO For Its Next Growth Push
items.summary: Best Buy (NYSE:BBY) has appointed Anne Bramman as Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President. Bramman is scheduled to assume the role on August 19, 2026. She brings experience from senior finance and analytics roles at Nordstrom, Circana, Avery Dennison, and Carnival Cruise Line. Best Buy enters this leadership change with its stock at $85.25 and a mixed performance profile.
